Ballari.data_nature: NASA POWER is a gridded product derived from satellite observations and reanalysis models (e.g. MERRA-2). Values describe a grid cell; they are not direct field or weather-station measurements.

descriptions.ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN: All Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Irradiance

processing_steps: Requested daily point data from NASA POWER API (JSON, UTC).
Converted fill value -999 and null to None (missing).
